method: Each definition in s4-mutation-defs.json applied alone by exact text replacement, its named test run alone (vitest -t), every touched file restored and compared by SHA-256, then the test rerun. Integration tests run on local PostgreSQL with the real schema built from the migrations; OpenAI is the labeled FIXTURE fake at the provider's fetch boundary (tests/support/fake-openai.ts). A proof also needs the mutated run to fail on an AssertionError.
